name: codex-visual-instructions
description: Implement local visual review sessions as source-aware UI changes without copying temporary DOM edits literally.

interface.shortDescription: Turn browser review intent into source changes
interface.longDescription: Reads local visual review sessions exposed by a page, locates the corresponding workspace source, implements compatible instructions together, and verifies the result in the browser.
defaultPrompt: Implement this page's visual review session.
List the open visual review instructions.
Verify the resolved visual changes in the browser.
